18.headline: Wembanyama drops 36 as Cambridge survives 24 lead changes
18.dek: Queens stormed back from 15 down to stun Ithaca, the 1 seed Gooners never trailed, Jokić flattened Manhattan with a triple-double, and Stony Brook lost a sixth straight.

games.text: The lead changed hands 24 times, which is less a basketball game than a custody dispute. Cambridge won it 109-108 at Waltham because Victor Wembanyama scored 36 with 13 rebounds and seven assists, and because the Platypuses put up 36 in the fourth quarter after managing 16 in the second. Cade Cunningham missed 14 of his 21 shots for the Bears, who stay the 4 seed at 10-8 but now have two 9-9 teams breathing on them. Cambridge is 6-12 and the 9 seed, and for one night nobody cared.

Ithaca led by 15, led by nine after three quarters, and then got run over. Queens ripped off a 36-point fourth quarter to steal it 102-99, with Donovan Mitchell pouring in 32 and Luka Dončić adding 28 points, 13 rebounds and nine assists. Jayson Tatum had 28 and 18 for the Thunder and launched 17 3-pointers, which is one way to protect a lead. The Pigeons hold the 2 seed at 13-5, a game behind first. Ithaca slipped from the 5 seed to the 6 seed and should stop watching the fourth quarter through its fingers.

Nikola Jokić had 35 points, 16 rebounds and 12 assists, and Manhattan had a long flight home to think about it. Toronto buried the Elephants 116-100, leading by 20, with LeBron James adding 28 on 12-of-16 shooting like a man returning a library book. The win lifts the Jays from the 6 seed to the 5 seed at 9-9, one game off the playoff line. Stephen Curry scored 30 for Manhattan, which has lost two straight and is the 7 seed in name only.

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 38 points and needed 28 shots to do it, because the alternative was passing to his teammates. Stony Brook led by 15, led after three quarters, and lost anyway, 120-115, its sixth straight defeat. Norman Powell torched the Stingrays for 26 on 10-of-16 and Anthony Edwards had 24 for Rochester, which was missing Jalen Brunson and Jalen Johnson and is still comfortably the 3 seed at 11-7. Stony Brook is 4-14, the 10 seed, and circling the drain clockwise.

A team called the Gooners is 14-4 and the 1 seed, and at some point the rest of the league will have to explain that to its families. Gooning never trailed against Durham, led by 22 and coasted home 107-100 without anyone scoring 20; RJ Barrett led with 19. Giannis Antetokounmpo missed 13 of his 20 shots and it made no difference. Pascal Siakam went 10-of-12 for 24 for the Destroyers, who were without De'Aaron Fox, have lost two straight and remain the 8 seed.
